whatsappMessage:
Hi Team isalon,

I noticed your salon has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from 1,380+ happy clients in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking page for new client appointments.

Maine aapke isalon ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp booking, hair & skin service menu, aur client gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/isalon

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team isalon, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke salon ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with your stellar 4.9-star reputation and prime location in Kidwaipuri, Patna, including direct WhatsApp booking and service menus. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
